prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic editorial lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman performing a controlled floor split in a warm modern living room.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long dark hair loosely tied back, silky texture, soft luminous natural makeup, and a glamorous yet approachable smile. She wears an oversized pure-white premium cotton T-shirt and is barefoot, with a small white plush dog or bear balanced playfully on her head. She sits in a wide floor split with upper body upright and hands cupping her face, keeping the pose safe and non-sexualized.
prompt.composition_elements: Wide vertical or landscape-capable full-body floor-level composition, subject centered and symmetrical on polished beige tile, warm LED shelving with collectible figures and white roller blinds behind. Keep the plush toy, white shirt, face, hands, legs, and clean room hierarchy visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large softbox from top-front with warm integrated shelf LEDs, soft reflections on tile, luxurious clean warm domestic setting, medium-shallow depth of field.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic 8K editorial detail, accurate anatomy and hands, realistic cotton, hair and tile texture, controlled background softness, subtle grain, no warped limbs.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic editorial lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with long dark hair loosely tied back, silky healthy texture, soft luminous natural makeup, and a glamorous yet approachable smile.
